Example Therapeutics Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Pipeline Update

CAMBRIDGE, Mass., Oct. 1, 2026 -- Example Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: EXTX) today reported financial results.

EXT-101 (zorbalimab): The Phase 3 HORIZON-2 trial in moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis completed enrollment of 640 patients. Topline data are expected in the first half of 2027.

EXT-202: The Company remains on track to report topline results from the Phase 2b SUMMIT trial in mid-2027.

Cash and cash equivalents were $412.5 million as of September 30, 2026.
